Alternatively, after exiting Sophanem, take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach, then take another carpet trip to Menaphos.
Imperial district

The sceptre of the gods can teleport the player directly to the Golden Palace (Jalkabir) in the Imperial district.
A fairy ring (CKQ) is located near the fountain behind the Golden Palace.
Port district
The player can speak to Quartermaster Gully on any of the islands in The Arc to return to Menaphos, but only if their starting point was Menaphos.

A charter ship to the north-western dock in the Port district for 1,500 coins.
Slayer Codex teleport and the boat to Menaphos can be used via Portmaster Kags.
Between districts
Travel between the four districts of Menaphos can be simplified by using a right-click interface on the entrance of the Shifting Tombs found in each district.

Prior to an update on 3 July 2017, a right click would give the option of "Quick travel RSFont | shadow=no | Shifting tombs | color=aqua ". Five options were available including entering the Shifting Tombs and quick travel to the entrance of each district's Shifting Tombs entrance.

place.title: Sophanem
place.summary: Sophanem was founded in the Second Age, shortly before the reign of Pharaoh Queen Senliten. It remained a relatively small village well into the Third Age, at which point the Kharidian Desert Campaign forced refugees from besieged settlements such as Uzer and Ullek to flee further south for survival. This re-location of most of the desert's populace essentially left Sophanem at the Menaphite nation's centre, eventually leading to its incorporation as part of a joint-capital with Menaphos.

get_inside.text: Lunar Sea

The Pirates' Cove can be accessed only by boat. Players may reach the island either by the 'Travel-Pirates' Cove' option on Lokar Searunner in Rellekka or by the 'Travel' option on Captain Bentley on Lunar Isle, provided they have reached a certain point in Lunar Diplomacy. There is no fee either way.

There are no teleportation methods through which a player can immediately reach the island; however, players may reach the Lady Zays port of call on Lunar Isle more quickly by using the Lunar Isle lodestone or the Moonclan Teleport found in the lunar spells, which is a reward for the Lunar Diplomacy quest. Players can also access Rellekka more quickly through a variety of means, including the enchanted lyre or House Teleport spell (provided their player-owned house is in Rellekka).
Pirates' Cove

place.title: Pirates' Cove
place.summary: The island is totally uninhabited except for a number of hostile moss giants. A number of pirates can also be found wandering the island, although they are presumably crewmen aboard the Lady Zay and not permanent residents. Although the Lady Zays crew typically appear to remain onboard their ship whenever possible, evidence of their activity on the island is obvious; supply crates, basic fences, flags, and other materials can be found dotted around the area, and a number of skeletal corpses can be found hanging from poles on the island's peak.

Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.

Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.
Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

There are many ways to travel to, from, and within Karamja.
Ship

A popular way to travel for free players is by ship from Port Sarim by talking to the men in front of the ship (first ship you come across heading east from the Port Sarim Lodestone), which costs 30gp for the trip. This can be reduced to 15gp, if you're a member, by completing the easy Karamja achievements, and completely free by using the Ring of charos(a). Another ship route is available from the Ardougne Docks to Brimhaven. Players who wish to travel by boat will have their inventories searched by customs officers, as the law prohibits individuals from carrying rum off the island. Those who wish to circumvent this and smuggle rum to the mainland may find it helpful to check the guide for the Pirate's Treasure quest, where the player must smuggle Karamja rum.

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Prerequisites
• Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest
• Entering the dungeon itself requires 60 Strength or 60 Agility 
• Entering each god encampment (therefore the boss rooms) has a skill requirement:
• Armadyl's Eyrie (south-west) - 70 Ranged 
• Bandos's Stronghold (north-west) - 70 Strength 
• Saradomin's Encampment (south-east) - 70 Agility 
• Zamorak's Fortress (north) - 70 Constitution 

Teleports
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills
• Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall
• God wars teleport tablet - Requires completion of The Mighty Fall
• Trollheim Teleport - Standard spells, requires level 61 Magic and completion of Eadgar's Ruse
• Trollheim tablet - Requires completed Love Story and taken the miner's diary to the Wise Old Man
• Trollheim Farm Teleport - Lunar spells, requires level 92 Magic, completion of My Arm's Big Adventure, and unlock at Livid Farm rewards

In general players use the tower for prestige or to gain its non-tradeable rewards rather than to make money. The history of the Tower is revealed in the Dominion journal, which is acquired as one beats bosses. The tower was constructed by an individual known as The Founder, while a stone face which is said to come from ancient times manages the tower.
